title: Auto Parry, Boss farm, Auto quests,More
features:
1. Autofarm Engine
+ Master Autofarm toggle
+ Target selection dropdown (Mobs)
+ Auto Eat toggle
+ Auto Grip Mobs
+ Attack Position override (Behind, Above, Below, Custom)
+ X/Y/Z offset tuning sliders
+ Global Tween Speed & Farm Smoothness controls
+ Player Farm (Target selection, Master toggle, Auto Grip Players, Refresh cache)
+ Boss Farm (Target selection, Master toggle, Auto Grip Bosses, Boss Auto Chest, Chest Items filter, Refresh cache)

2. Combat & Automation
+ Attack Method selection (Remote / VIM)
+ Heavy Attack Automation (with Interval slider)
+ Kill Aura (Auto Attack with adjustable range slider)
+ Auto Equip Weapon
+ Auto Use Skill (Skill dropdown & Interval slider)
+ Auto Collect Chests (with dedicated tween speed slider & items filter)
+ Auto Sell (Items dropdown, Master toggle)

3. Auto Parry Engine
+ Master Auto Parry toggle
+ Auto-Learn New Attacks & Parry Unknown Attacks
+ Feint Detection (with Threshold % slider)
+ Parry Notifications (Style selection)
+ Ping Compensation / Timing Offset (ms) & Dodge Lead Time
+ Parry Method (Auto, Remote, Key) & Custom Keybind
+ Block Hold Time & Default Hit % slider
+ Target filters (Ignore Players, Ignore NPCs/Mobs)
+ FOV Limit & Max Distance restrictors
+ Target Priority (All, Closest Only, Lowest HP) & Max Tracked Targets
+ Hitbox Visuals
+ Auto Dodge Heavy/Grab (Threat radius, Evasion method)
+ Face Lock (Face Attacker, Sticky Target, Smooth)
+ Player Whitelist management
+ Timing DB (Save/Edit/Delete/Capture specific animations, Blacklist)
+ Live Logger & Animation Visualizer tools

4. Quest Automation
+ Master Auto Quest toggle
+ NPC selection dropdown
+ NPC Travel Speed slider

5. Player Manipulation
+ WalkSpeed (Toggle & Slider)
+ JumpPower (Toggle & Slider)
+ Infinite Jump
+ Noclip
+ Flight (Toggle & Speed Slider)
+ Click TP
+ Spawn Teleport & Respawn utilities
+ World Teleporter (Portal Dropdown)

6. Network Exploits
+ Highlight Owned Entities
+ Insta Kill (Range slider)
+ Freeze Mobs (Range slider)
+ Mob AI Breaker
+ Anti Fall Damage

7. Aim Assist & Hitboxes
+ Aim Master (Aimbot with Part target selection & Smoothness)
+ FOV Circle (Toggle & Radius slider)
+ Hitbox Extender (Master toggle & Size slider)
+ Target Player Actions

8. Visuals & ESP
+ Master ESP Toggle
+ Filters (Players, Hollows, Bosses, Quests, Chests)
+ ESP Styles (Rainbow, Boxes/Highlight, Names, Distance, Tracers)
+ Tracer Origin & Max Distance slider
+ World Visuals (Fullbright, No Fog, Chams)
+ Hide Entities (Players, Enemy Mobs, Bosses, Friendly NPCs)
+ Name Spoofer

9. Auto Securis (Boss Loop)
+ Master Auto Securis toggle
+ Securis Cave Key & Reset Key dropdowns
+ Securis Auto Chest & Items filter

10. Utilities & Misc
+ Performance Boosters (FPS Booster, Anti-AFK)
+ Block Teleport
+ Generate Misc EXP
